title: Fun for all
text: This experience was even better than expected.  I booked as a surprise for my husband for his birthday and everything was perfect from beginning to end.  Our instructor, Chef Matteo, was amazing.  Sharing history, techniques, hand tricks and funny little jokes… he was truly took the experience over the top.  I would highly recommend this cooking class to everyone … whether you love to cook or just love to eat.  Ha! You will have a great time and learn something along the way!
author: marteeb2024

title: Touring the market and cooking paella
text:
Was a great experience! We learned a lot and had a wonderful time! 
Mateo was such a great chef and we really enjoyed our time.
author: Adena_M

title: Excellent experience
text: We had an excellent experience.  John was professional and very friendly.  We learned a lot and would recommend this class to anyone.  Thanks!
author: Livia_V

title: A must fun paella cooking class
text:
Matteo was fantastic. As the chef, he made this a fun and informative experience. He’s the best!!!

Making seafood paella was a great experience and our group of 8 got to know each other and enjoy the experience immensely. 

Sangria and pouring wine from a decanter without touching your lips gave us all time to laugh and wash our faces in wine hahaha. 

Thank you Matteo for a wonderful market tour and paella cooking class!
author: Jack_R

title: Market Tour and Paella Cooking Class
text: John met us and took us through a tour of the market and then onto the cooking class.  It was a fantastic night with my wife and two sons and would highly recommend to anyone.  Should have done it earlier in the trip.  We found the trip on Viator and had a blast.
author: Matt_S

title: Paella experience extraordinaire!
text: Great experience learning the intricacies of cooking Paella.  Enjoyed it with 5 other people which made the experience even more enjoyable.  We got to taste the Paella and had fabulous wines. The Paella was the best one we had in our 4 days in Barcelona!! We also got to visit the market and shopped for our ingredients.
author: Alice_H

title: 10/10 experience!
text: Amazing cooking class! Very knowledgeable chef and fun class!
author: lfranks467

title: Great tour!
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our paella making class. The chef, the food, the laughter, the sangria and cava were great! Matt was a wonderful guide and chef. It was a small friendly fun group. Our tour of the market and participation in preparation was great.  I highly recommend this tour. Don’t hesitate!
author: susieskifla

title: We enjoyed the experience...
text: We enjoyed the experience very much. From the market tour and sampling to eating the delicious seafood paella we made, John was the perfect host and instructor. The kitchen is a beautiful, intimate space for our evening class.
author: Carol_S

title: Matteo was fantastic, 10/10 recommend!
text: Matteo was fantastic, family had a great time and would definitely recommend!
